verdict: Jibble: Choose Jibble when accurate time & attendance with GPS/face recognition — and a generous free plan — is the primary job. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Clear Premium / Ultimate paid ladder (confirm live)
weaknesses: Not an ATS or SOP training tool
bestFor: Teams needing GPS/face-recognition time & attendance without per-user free-plan caps
Hourly and field workers who clock in on mobile
Buyers who want Slack/Teams/QuickBooks attendance sync
notIdealFor: Orgs whose primary job is full frontline scheduling + comms hubs
Buyers who need AI-assisted SOP/training content platforms
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth
Opaque contact-sales pricing vs transparent published seats
recommendation: Choose Jibble when accurate time & attendance with GPS/face recognition — and a generous free plan — is the primary job. Compare Connecteam for broader frontline WFM, Breezy for ATS hiring, and Trainual for SOP training documentation.
editorialNotes: HR Wave-1 batch. Approved on hr-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=time-attendance. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Jibble markets simple mobile/kiosk clock-in with face recognition and GPS — low friction for hourly and field teams. Score from first-party positioning, not lab testing.
Primary job is time & attendance. Strong cluster fit; light scheduling does not make it a Connecteam WFM peer or Breezy ATS peer.
Timesheets, GPS/geofence, face recognition, and attendance policies deliver solid time-attendance workflows; deeper WFM hubs live elsewhere.
Slack, Teams, QuickBooks plus Zapier-style cover common payroll/comms stacks; held at 7 vs broader WFM ecosystems.
GPS and face-recognition clock-in are built for mobile/field attendance — excellent frontline readiness for the time job.
Attendance reporting is present; depth is adequate for SMB time tracking, not workforce analytics suites.
Unlimited free users is a strong start; paid Premium/Ultimate/Enterprise ladder supports policy depth as teams grow.
Free forever unlimited users is an outstanding entry; paid seats ~$4.49–$7.99 annual (medium confidence) keep paid TCO accessible. Affiliate economics excluded.
No meaningful published AI assistant/recommendation packaging comparable to ATS Intelligence or LMS AI credits — scored low on this criterion.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS/recruiting, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
